units.source_text: “等我回来，我中午之前一定能赶回来。”

en.t: Wait until I come back. I will definitely be able to get back before noon.

units.source_text: 他手里拎着西装，反复叮嘱信子。

en.t: Holding his suit in his hand, he repeatedly reminded Nobuko.

units.source_text: 信子纤细的手上拿着俊吉的礼帽，递给他，沉默的笑笑。

en.t: Nobuko held Shunkichi's hat in her slender hand, handed it to him, and smiled silently.
